System.assertEquals(false, error.equals(otherError)); System.assertNotEquals(0, error.hashCode()); System.assert(error.toString().contains('bad')); Database.GetDeletedResult deleted = new Database.GetDeletedResult(); otherDeleted.latestdatecovered = Date.today().addDays(-1); System.assertEquals(1, deleted.deletedrecords.size()); System.assertEquals(Date.today(), deleted.latestdatecovered); System.assertEquals(false, deleted.equals(otherDeleted)); System.assertNotEquals(0, deleted.hashCode()); System.assert(deleted.toString().contains('GetDeletedResult')); Database.GetUpdatedResult updated = new Database.GetUpdatedResult(); updated.ids = new List<Id>{'001000000000001AAA'}; updated.latestdatecovered = Date.today(); Database.GetUpdatedResult otherUpdated = new Database.GetUpdatedResult(); otherUpdated.ids = new List<Id>{'001000000000002AAA'}; System.assertEquals(1, updated.ids.size()); System.assertEquals(Date.today(), updated.latestdatecovered); System.assertEquals(false, updated.equals(otherUpdated)); System.assertNotEquals(0, updated.hashCode()); System.assert(updated.toString().contains('GetUpdatedResult')); Database.LeadConvertResult leadResult = new Database.LeadConvertResult(); leadResult.accountid = '001000000000001AAA'; leadResult.contactid = '003000000000001AAA'; leadResult.leadid = '00Q000000000001AAA'; leadResult.opportunityid = '006000000000001AAA'; leadResult.relatedpersonaccountid = '001000000000002AAA'; leadResult.success = true; leadResult.errors = new List<Database.Error>{error}; Database.LeadConvertResult otherLeadResult = new Database.LeadConvertResult(); otherLeadResult.opportunityid = '006000000000002AAA'; System.assertEquals('006000000000001AAA', leadResult.opportunityid); System.assertEquals('001000000000002AAA', leadResult.relatedpersonaccountid); System.assertEquals(1, leadResult.errors.size()); System.assertEquals(false, leadResult.equals(otherLeadResult)); System.assertNotEquals(0, leadResult.hashCode()); Database.MergeRequest mergeRequest = new Database.MergeRequest(); mergeRequest.masterrecord = new Account(Name = 'Merge Master'); mergeRequest.recordtomergeids = new List<String>{'001000000000001AAA', '001000000000002AAA'}; Database.MergeRequest otherMergeRequest = new Database.MergeRequest(); otherMergeRequest.recordtomergeids = new List<String>{'001000000000003AAA'}; System.assertEquals(2, mergeRequest.recordtomergeids.size()); System.assertEquals(false, mergeRequest.equals(otherMergeRequest)); System.assertNotEquals(0, mergeRequest.hashCode()); System.assert(mergeRequest.toString().contains('MergeRequest'));
